IS 17404 : 2020 Electrogalvanized Hot Rolled and Cold Reduced Carbon Steel Sheets and Strips-Specification
ICS 77.140.50
MTD 04
New Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard covers the requirements of hot rolled and cold reduced carbon steel sheets and strips coated with zinc by electrolytic process.
1.2 The product can be coated on one or both the surfaces and with equal or differential coating masses on the two surfaces.
2 REFERENCES
The following standards contain provisions which through in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:
